rows.grounds: imperative verb expressing a wish for protection
divine group invoked as protectors; final visarga lost in sandhi
compound indicating accompaniment by the host of Maruts

items.question: Which divine groups are invoked to grant protection to the addressed person?
premises: The Vasus are called upon to protect.
The Rudras are called upon to protect.
The Adityas together with the host of Maruts are called upon to protect.
items.inference: Multiple divine groups collectively act as protectors of the addressed person.
items.plain_english: May the Vasus, the Rudras, and the Adityas, together with the host of Maruts, protect you.
